fit_reason: Whole SUV listed by a private owner in cars by owner.
findings: Hazy, yellowed headlight lenses on the front corners
Dark blue paint looks somewhat flat and dull on the hood and doors under overcast light
Black plastic lower bumper and front grille trim look faded and grayish
Light road film along the lower doors and rocker area
message: Hi, we saw your CR-V listing and it looks like a solid, well-kept vehicle. The headlights are looking a bit hazy and the black bumper trim has faded some, both things that show up in photos. We do mobile pre-sale details, including headlight and trim restoration and a polish to bring back gloss on the blue paint. Would you like a quote?
